clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers find the Thunderbrew Distillery at the heart of Kharanos, where ale and shelter await. Its brewhouse and tavern draw mountain travelers, while mentors and tradesfolk offer their skills within.

The Thunderbrew Distillery anchors Kharanos in southern Dun Morogh. Arkilus Thunderbrew founded the brewhouse, and his kin have kept it in the family. Across Khaz Modan, its strong ales are known for warming those who face the mountain cold. Innkeeper Belm manages the inn, where weary mountaineers find a fire, hearty food, and beds beyond the blizzards outside.

Kharanos is the first major settlement travelers reach after leaving Coldridge Valley, and the distillery gathers many kinds of instructors beneath its timber rafters. Teachers offer lessons in martial arts, holy rites, arcane studies, and roguecraft, alongside cooking and first aid. The hall pours its well-known stouts, but also gives travelers a place to prepare for the road ahead.
